fixed: [Slots Loader] An extra outfit made from a game outfit now keeps its own look when a Replace original mod is installed over that outfit: the textures it ships are used, and its parts no longer show black or take the replacement's material.
[Slots Loader] An extra outfit also takes the parts its outfit borrows from another outfit's folder (a hair, a head): the mod's version of them now shows instead of the game's.
modified: [Slots Loader] Slotsloader Manager installs: extra outfits ignore the replacements installed over the game and keep the game's own files for everything their mod does not ship.
[Slots Loader] The first start after this update builds the extra outfits again, once. It can take a few minutes with many mods.

fixed: [Native Core] The game could close at the start of an update accepted in the game's offer box: nothing was installed and a second try worked. Fixed for the updates after this one; this update itself is still installed by the previous code.
[Slots Loader] The same fix, for an install without the Native Core.
[Recording Manager] The same fault is removed from its short on-screen messages.

new: [Slots Loader] Installed by the Slotsloader Manager: Random can follow your own list of outfits, repeats and colours, made in the Manager.
fixed: [Slots Loader] A mod whose variants each need its main files (Requirement= in modinfo.ini) now gives every variant those files. Such an outfit could lack its textures.
modified: [Slots Loader] The two colour squares of a mod outfit's colours are measured on the outfit's surface and on its textures. Outfits that had no squares now get them.
[Slots Loader] The first start after this update writes the loader's files again, once. It can take a minute or two with many mods.

[Native Core] When the Slotsloader Manager installed the Slots Loader, the Core now only serves the Slots Loader (stage pictures, menu texts): no title line, no release number, no News tabs. Nothing changes for other installs.

fixed: [Recording Manager] Reversal Settings: rows 11 to 30 now play even when no row 1 to 10 is active in any of the three tabs.
[Recording Manager] Changing the dummy (P2) from the pause menu could move one character's reversal rows onto the other and lose them. Each character keeps its own rows.
[Custom Combos] Replay Menu: End Replay was missing from Playback Settings. Every row is there again, and the rows sit a little closer together so that all of them fit in the frame.
[Slots Loader] Online, the outfit and colour sent to the other players are now checked whatever your save holds. A choice made with an older version could go online as it was.
modified: [Slots Loader] Online, an outfit or a colour your account really owns is sent as it is again: your opponent sees it. Everything else stays on your PC only, and the others see Outfit 1 or DriveTech in Color 1 or 2.
[Slots Loader] A mod outfit is offered when the game outfit it is made from is yours.

fixed: [Native Core] News > OverDrive Changelog: the tab could leave the News screen stuck when a release's notes were long, as 1.50.0's were. Close the game (Alt+F4) if it happened to you; this version fixes it.

new: [Slots Loader] Replays > Settings: a new Costume value, My Own, shows the outfit and colour you really wore in each of your online matches. A Color Mod colour (RW / MC) is shown for the matches played from this version on.
fixed: [Slots Loader] Battle Hub, V-Rival: a fighter wearing a mod outfit was invisible and lost at once.
[Slots Loader] Random outfit and colour: several faults fixed, among them Random lost after an online set and colours that were never drawn.
[Slots Loader] Replays > Settings: some of your own matches were not recognised as yours.
[Slots Loader] Training: a mod stage or a variation of the stage already loaded now shows at once.
[Slots Loader] Outfit names: the mod outfits keep their names after another program rebuilt the costume file.
[Native Core] Options: the game could freeze when the pages were changed quickly (L2 / R2).
[Custom Combos] Rhythm mode follows the fight's own clock: Take Over, the first action, MISS and the game speeds.
modified: [Slots Loader] Replays > Settings: a character left Off shows what the replay recorded. Your real outfit is the My Own value.

fixed: [Slots Loader] Online, other players now only ever see Outfit 1 or DriveTech (your Outfit Others See choice) in Color 1 or 2, whatever you wear: mod outfits, the game's other outfits, Color Mod colours, Random. You still see your real choice. This should end the 50301-30003 errors.
[Slots Loader] Your own replays show the game outfit and colour you really wore.
modified: [Slots Loader] Outfit 1 or DriveTech in Color 3 or above shows Color 1 or 2 on the VS screen; the fight itself shows your colour.

new: [Custom Combos] Rhythm mode: Input History Display has a third value, Rhythm. The trial's inputs come down to a line like a rhythm game, each press judged Perfect, Marvelous, Early, Late or Miss, held buttons drawn as corridors. The recipe's asked strength wins over the example's button.

[Custom Combos] Watch Example has the replay's control bar: play / pause, one frame back or forward (across Drive Impacts and supers, down to the first frame), previous / next input (L1 / R1), previous / next recipe line (L2 / R2).
[Custom Combos] During an example, Up / Down and the pause menu's Game Speed set 50%, 80%, Standard or 150%; the speed icon under the Frame Meter shows play, pause and the speed.
[Suite] Each release's news can have its own picture, set on the community server.
fixed: [Slots Loader] A title screen pack without its own loop or end movie kept the previous pack's movies after a switch: it now gets the game's own.
[Slots Loader] A title screen pack's music and narrator follow the pack chosen. A pack whose sounds the game cannot play keeps the game's own sounds instead of a silent title.
[Slots Loader] The unpacked copies of stage, title and UI mod archives no longer pile up: the ones no mod uses any more are removed.
[Suite] Starting an update could crash the game in rare cases (its progress strip).

[Custom Combos] Doctor's Office: Send Symptoms refused your own replay on a PC where the Recording Manager had never linked to the Community, or had linked under another name. You are now recognised by your user code of the game, the number the replay holds for each player.
modified: [Custom Combos] Doctor's Office: Send Symptoms needs the game connected to its network (your user code comes from it). Without it, a message says so.

new: [Profile Mod] Zen Mode now works with every REFramework, the public 1.5.8 included. It used to need a nightly build: on an older one it was switched off without a word. Nothing to set: the Native Core now hooks the game's interface drawing itself when REFramework cannot do it.
fixed: [Recording Manager] Drive Rush moves in Reversal Settings: after a perfect parry taken when the player had jumped over the dummy, the dummy stayed in its parry and no rush came out. It now rushes on the 3rd frame, as when facing the player.

[Recording Manager] Drive Rush moves: the move after the rush was lost when the rush started a little late. Its button is now pressed inside the rush's window in every situation, Medium Punch and Medium Kick included.

[Recording Manager] Reversal Settings: pressing a row that holds a Drive Rush move opens the action list on Normal Moves, Drive Rush mode on, the cursor on that move. It used to open on Record, Slot 8.
modified: [Recording Manager] Drive Rush moves come out as early as the game allows: on the frame after a normal parry (one frame earlier than before), on the 3rd frame after a block, a hit, a wake-up or a perfect parry. MP+MK stays held until the rush starts.

[Recording Manager] After a perfect parry the dummy lets the parry go for one frame and presses it again: the game then gives its usual invincibility, and the frame meter shows the first 2 frames of the rush as invincible.
[Recording Manager] A Reversal Settings row with a Delay keeps the game's own timing: its Drive Rush comes out that many frames later.

new: [Recording Manager] Training > Reversal Settings: a Drive Rush version of every normal move. In the action list's Normal Moves tab, press Y (keyboard: T): the twelve moves become their Drive Rush versions, Y again brings the normal moves back.

[Recording Manager] Choose one (Drive Rush Light Punch ... Drive Rush Crouching Heavy Kick): the dummy does a raw Drive Rush then that move, starting on its very first free frame (wake-up, after a block, after a hit).

[Custom Combos] Doctor's Office: a case shows a picture of its moment (the frame its patient paused on), both players' names, when it was sent, and the best prescription so far with its sender's name.
[Suite] News: a red dot on every news of the suite not seen yet (a release's notes, a new case, a result that is out), a badge on its tab, and News' notification mark in the Multi Menu.
fixed: [Custom Combos] Doctor's Office: treating a case of a second replay in the same session did not start by itself and could land on another case's moment.
[Custom Combos] Doctor's Office: the list could say "No case yet" the first time it was opened; a watch's message could show on the next replay.
modified: [Custom Combos] Doctor's Office: symptoms can only be sent from your own replays (you are the patient), and one case at a time: the next one once yours is closed.
[Custom Combos] Doctor's Office: the time left reads HH:MM:SS, and dates come with their time.

new: [Custom Combos] Doctor's Office (Fighting Ground > Special Match). A patient pauses one of their replays (Multi Menu > Replays) and chooses Send Symptoms: that moment becomes a case, open to everyone for 24 hours.

[Custom Combos] A doctor picks a case in Doctor's Office: its replay opens on that very frame, Press Start, and you play the patient from there. The most damage for the fewest Drive and Super Art bars; Reset Battle starts again; one prescription per case, final.
[Custom Combos] Doctor's Office > Results: your place while a case is open, the podium once it is closed, and Watch replays a prescription from the case's moment.
modified: [Suite] Doctor's Office needs the Recording Manager's community link (Steam verification) and an internet connection.
[Suite] The OverDrive Changelog news show the Slots Loader's cover picture (needs an internet connection).
[Slots Loader] Its zip carries a cover picture for Fluffy Mod Manager and the Slotsloader Manager.

new: [Suite] News has a new tab, OverDrive Changelog: what each release of the suite brought, since 1.30.0.
[Suite] The update offer has a Details key (T / pad Y): what's new in every release since the one you have.

fixed: [Custom Combos] A custom trial is now marked cleared only when you clear that trial.
modified: [Custom Combos] Clear marks show in the trial list, the pause menu and Uncleared only; official clears stay untouched.

new: [Profile Mod] The Battle Hub Player List shows each player's MR, or League Points if they have no MR.
[Profile Mod] The Player List SORT menu has a new MR row, ascending or descending.
modified: [Profile Mod] The Player List keeps your chosen sort, even after a restart.
[Profile Mod] hub_rating=0 in profile_mod.ini turns off the MR column and sort.
[Profile Mod] Zen Mode does not hide the new MR column yet.

fixed: [Slots Loader] Random outfit in Arcade, Training and Versus now gives a real random outfit and colour.
[Custom Combos] Lists show only combos of their own control type (Classic or Modern).
modified: [Custom Combos] A fighter with no Modern combo shows only the [REC] row in Modern.

fixed: [Custom Combos] 34 Ryu combos start again on the Counter or Punish Counter they were recorded with.
modified: [Custom Combos] 553 community combos for 31 fighters, 52 more, each validated by the game.
[Custom Combos] A dash, jump, parry or Drive Rush after the last hit is no longer judged.
[Suite] The title screen shows the suite's version.

new: [Custom Combos] New mod: your own combo trials in Fighting Ground > Practice > Custom Combos.
[Custom Combos] Record a combo with the [REC] row, or from a replay with Start Combo Recording.
[Custom Combos] 501 community combos for 31 fighters come with it, credited to their authors.
[Custom Combos] Rename, move or delete a trial with T (pad Y) in the list.
[Custom Combos] Auto Reset On Fail and the Frame Meter can be used inside a trial.
[Suite] SF6_CrashReport.bat gathers a crash into a zip and can send it to the mods' team.
fixed: [Suite] Title screen left on Random could go black when the background changed; this is fixed.
[Custom Combos] Examples now play the same at Game Speed 50 percent and 100 percent.
[Custom Combos] Dash and jump steps are no longer wrongly judged as must-hit.
modified: [Suite] The updater now also updates Custom Combos.
[Slots Loader] Better support for installs made with ZZtaii's Slotsloader Manager.
[Custom Combos] Trials that end on a Critical Art now start you at 20 percent life.

new: [Suite] The update box has a Show zip button that opens the folder with the downloaded zips.
modified: [Suite] Updates keep the downloaded zips, so Fluffy Mod Manager users can replace them there.

new: [Slots Loader] Title screen packs shipped as a .pak file are now read.
modified: [Slots Loader] Outfit names from archive files no longer show .rar, .zip or .7z.
[Mod Sorter] Recognizes title packs shipped as a .pak file.

new: [Mod Sorter] The tool now updates itself from its Options tab.
[Suite] The game's side message shows the download percentage during an update.
[Mod Sorter] New tool: drop downloaded mods on it and it installs each one where the game reads it.
[Mod Sorter] It checks for new suite releases and installs them with the game closed.
[Mod Sorter] An Installed tab lists your mods with pictures and can mark costumes as NSFW.
[Suite] The game now offers new suite releases at the main menu: Yes, No or Ignore.
[Suite] Updates are checked and installed all at once, then the game offers to restart.
modified: [Suite] The update check can be turned off (check_for_updates false in its state.json).

new: [Profile Mod] Zen Mode hides ranks, League Points / MR, win streaks, player names and player details.
[Profile Mod] A new Zen Mode tab in Battle Settings turns each group Hidden or Shown.
modified: [Profile Mod] Zen Mode replaces ZenMode.lua and needs a recent REFramework nightly build.

fixed: [Color Mod] The Random value is back in Battle Settings > Fighter Settings.
[Color Mod] Each character keeps its own Random colour in Fighter Settings.
[Slots Loader] Every character set to Random keeps its Random colour in battle.
[Slots Loader] Confirming Random in the Training popup draws a colour at once.

new: [Slots Loader] Random colour at the end of every Color row, never repeating before all were worn.
[Slots Loader] Random outfit and Random colour in Replays > Settings.
[Slots Loader] In ranked matches, Random only draws outfits you really own.
fixed: [Slots Loader] Tab back on Recommended Replays now opens Settings.
modified: [Slots Loader] The Random outfit now draws RW and MC colours too.
[Slots Loader] Random is no longer offered in Opponent Outfit Settings.
